notes: Community-maintained wiki guide, parsed programmatically — see data/README.md for the caveat and the Quest sheet backstop. The site splits this guide by expansion (the URL given only covers ARR levels 1-50); all six pages were fetched and merged here to reach level 110. Quest names are cleaned of the wiki's own disambiguation suffixes (e.g. per-starting-city variants like 'Simply the Hest (Limsa Lominsa)' become 'Simply the Hest') to match the game's actual quest names, but have NOT been cross-checked against xivapi's Quest sheet — verify before treating an exact name as ground truth. Entries with 3 alternative quests (one per starting city/Grand Company) are split into separate array entries sharing the same level+unlock; see each entry's notes for AND-chain / prerequisite / alternative caveats. The newest section (Evercold, levels 100-110) is a still-being-documented wiki stub as of the fetch date: many of its entries have quest: null with a 'wiki placeholder (???)' note. REPAIRED 2026-08-23: quest names reconciled against the live Quest sheet. 33 wiki placeholder/duplicate rows removed. Every entry now carries a `confidence` and a `sources` list: `verified` means the quest name resolves to exactly one live Quest row, so the wiki and the game agree and the game supplies the gates; `single-source` means only one source establishes the link, or the requirement is curated from a server-side condition the client cannot read; `unverified` means nothing in the game data backs the entry, and it carries `requires.unverifiable` so it is never reported as available.
